title: Multi-Model EDF Structural-Value Benchmark
primaryQuestion: Does EDF add semantic diagnostic value beyond natural analysis and a matched neutral structure under evidence-isolated, blinded, multi-model conditions?
competingExplanation: Generic structure, extra prompting, or serialization discipline explains any apparent benefit rather than EDF-specific semantics.

primaryOutcome.name: blinded semantic utility
primaryOutcome.marginRationale: Five points equals one rubric-step improvement in one of the five equally weighted dimensions on average. It is fixed before execution.

successCriteria: Mean EDF minus matched-neutral across 18 paired primary units is at least +5 points.
A seeded paired-bootstrap 95% confidence interval for EDF minus matched-neutral has lower bound above 0.
At least two of three analyzer executor families have positive mean EDF minus matched-neutral differences.
EDF has no more than one additional materially flagged primary unit for outside-evidence use or forbidden claims than matched-neutral.
falsificationCriteria: Matched-neutral is non-inferior to EDF within the fixed 5-point margin, or EDF paired bootstrap interval includes zero.
Any apparent EDF advantage depends on one executor family and disappears or reverses in the other two.
EDF introduces more than one additional materially flagged primary unit relative to matched-neutral.
naturalComparison: Natural analysis is a secondary comparator. HY-EDF-008 is specifically about incremental value beyond matched neutral structure.
stopRules: Stop and mark infrastructure failure if evidence isolation cannot be enforced for any analyzer executor.
Stop before confirmatory execution if executor-matrix.json is not confirmatory-ready.
Preserve failed attempts; never silently replace them.
Do not alter prompts, cases, rubric, ground truth, scoring code, or margins after the first confirmatory run. Any change creates a new experiment version.

analysisPlan.primary: Paired differences on evaluator-family-aggregated semantic utility by case x analyzer executor.
analysisPlan.bootstrap: 10000 paired bootstrap resamples with deterministic seed derived from randomization seed plus |bootstrap.
analysisPlan.evaluatorDisagreement: If E1 and E2 differ by >=20 points, require E3 before inclusion.

claimGate: Only HY-EDF-008 may be directly advanced by this experiment. Other hypotheses require construct-matched evidence.
